1], {\n        opacity: 0,\n        scale: 0.8,\n        rotation: 180,\n        duration: morphTime / 2,\n        ease: \"power2.in\"\n      }, startTime - morphTime / 2)\n      \n      // Fade in current shape\n      .to(shape, {\n        opacity: 1,\n        scale: 1,\n        rotation: 0,\n        duration: morphTime / 2,\n        ease: \"power2.out\"\n      }, startTime)\n      \n      // Add morph effect\n      .to(meteor, {\n        borderRadius: &#96;${50 + index * 10}% ${50 -
